stories.summary: South African lawmakers demanded transparency over state carrier South African Airways' financial records, its competitiveness, and the August National Treasury debt guarantee.

impacts.name: South Africa
impacts.why: Deregulating exchange controls attracts cross-border institutional capital and enhances financial sector liquidity.
